basics.name: Abhishek Pandey
basics.label: Mechanical Design Engineer
basics.summary: I am a Mechanical Design Engineer with experience in product development across electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, and ergonomic consumer products. With a Master's in Design Science from the University of Michigan and industry experience at Godrej & Boyce and BarrelCharge Solution Inc., I specialize in CAD modeling, sheet metal design, structural analysis (FEA), and cross-functional collaboration for efficient, manufacturable solutions. My work has led to measurable improvements in cost reduction, product performance, and design optimization. I’ve also contributed to motorsport-inspired academic projects like SAE Baja and Human Powered Vehicles, reinforcing my ability to design with both precision and creativity. Motivated by a passion for innovation and sustainability, I strive to develop functional, user-centered designs that deliver real-world impact.

He consistently balanced academic and project responsibilities, delivering well-documented, technically sound work that enabled us to move forward with product development. Abhishek is technically strong, collaborative, and highly responsive—I’m confident he will be a valuable asset to any engineering team.
